out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counter. Observed wet wiping clothes on counters
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses.CFM will prepare sanitizer buckets to store the wet wiping clothes

violations.title: Equipment Clean to Sight and Touch
violations.observation: Encrusted grease deposits and/or other soil deposits were observed on the food contact surfaces of the following cooking equipment: Observed protective film on the 3-door flat top cooler (new)
violations.corrective_action: The food-contact surfaces of cooking equipment and pans shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other soil accumulations. A surface that is soiled cannot be effectively sanitized.CFM will remove protective film from the new 3 dr cooler

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed that hand soap was not provided at the handwashing sink, located next to dish machine.
violations.corrective_action: The CFM provided hand soap at the hand sink during the inspection for compliance.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: diced tomatoes (47F), meat chili (47F, 48F, 46F), sliced turkey (47F), chicken strips (47F), loaded potato soup (46F), chicken dumpling soup (49F), meatballs (47F) in #4
violations.corrective_action: The CFM discarded the food items during the inspection for compliance.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: loaded potato soup, chicken and dumpling soup, chili, sliced turkey meat in #4
violations.corrective_action: The CFM discarded the food items due to improper temperature control within the refrigeration unit, so date marking correction was no longer necessary. FIREHOUSE SUBS (Inspection Date: 12/09/2024) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Food Thermometers, Provided & Accessible
violations.observation: The certified food manager could not provide a metal -stemmed food temperature measuring device.
violations.corrective_action: The CFM placed a purchase order for a metal-stemmed temperature measuring device (thermometer) during the inspection for compliance.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: multiple containers of Au jus sauce and oil in storage area without common names.
violations.corrective_action: The CFM labeled the food items with the common names for compliance, during the inspection.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: the TRUE 3 DR UR cooler was registering at 50F on the external thermometer. The food items inside of the refrigeration unit registered at 46F or 47F consistently, correlating to prolonged ambient temperature issues.
violations.corrective_action: The CFM manually adjusted the temperature control box within the refrigeration unit and the ambient temperature returned to 35F, after a wait-period. The food items that registered above 41F were discarded during the inspection. The manager reported that the refrigeration unit will solely be used for non TCS products.
